card.name: Recovery words after withhold until
card.fires_on: The word right after "withhold/interrupt [drug] until" in dose-hold instructions, such as recovery, resolved, resolves or the "or" that follows resolves.

modes.label: Recovery noun or verb
modes.description: A recovery or resolution word directly after "until" in a hold instruction.
modes.example: Withhold IBTROZI until<< recovery>> to Grade ≤1 or baseline. If

modes.label: Or after resolves
modes.description: The word "or" after "resolved/resolves" in a hold-until condition.
modes.example: Interrupt sorafenib tablets until resolved<< or>> improved to Grade 0 to 1

card.writes: It suppresses "or" in several languages, which pushes the output away from adding an alternative.
card.plain: It marks the point in a "hold the drug until it clears" instruction where the recovery condition is stated.
